verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of Datadog showing your own observability spend or usage, attributing it to teams or services, or alerting on usage spikes before the bill. The Cloud Cost Management item is only a title and concerns cloud infrastructure cost, which is an adjacent feature. Monitors are a generic building block, not a spend-tracking capability.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can see what my observability spend is, attribute it to teams or services, and catch usage spikes before the bill
